title: Notion Database — embedded DB surface with 6 views
description: Portable Notion-style database surface. Optional companion to notion-shell. NotionDatabase ships full DB UI with ViewTabs + ViewOptions + per-column menu + 6 views (Table/Board/List/Gallery/Calendar/Feed) + 10 property-cell types. Pure / props-driven. Lifted from notion-page-clone (Nosion).

peers.reason: Domain types (Database, Property, PropertyValue, DbView, DatabaseViewConfig, DatabaseFilter, DatabaseSort) live in notion-shell — the Page type references them via rowOfDatabaseId + rowProps so they stay in the shell's domain model.
